items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know that man, Paulie Christian, Frenchie or whatever you want to call him? [INTERVIEWEE] Frenchie, Paulie Christian.

ctx.x: One time I had a spirit club, I had 10 waitresses, a head waiter, and 2 car parkers on the outside of the park. This was a massive operation. It took in $190,000 the first pair of 9 months out there. But so overall, the payroll was run, as I told you yesterday, from $2,000 to $2,500. And then of course we had the taxes each quarter of the payroll. This would go up to the thousands. The profit wasn't $190,000, but a big portion of it was. You'd pay off your investment and then you'd carry the oldest of the world.…
You know that man, Paulie Christian, Frenchie or whatever you want to call him?
